tspan.tspan: Figure 2.A) Hierarchical clustering based on the spatial similarity between the group-average brain maps of
each cortical excitability/inhibition (E/I) measure. B) Contribution of each brain region to the separability of
the six identified clusters. C) Distribution of individual-level alignments between each E/I cluster and cortical
thickness. An asterisk denotes distributions whose mean is significantly different from zero. D) Spatial
correlation between each E/I cluster and neurotransmitter receptor density maps typically associated with
excitability. Statistically significant correlations based on spin-permutation testing are highlighted.
